text: my company gives me 5 lakh group cover, so why would I pay extra
I'm covered by my employer's group policy, so I don't need my own health insurance.

chain.why: Employer cover belongs to the employer's group policy; the regulator's option to move it into your own name applies only when you leave the group.
A fresh policy bought after leaving a job, rather than migrated, starts its waiting periods from zero.
About 1 in 9 Indian adults aged 20 and over has diabetes, and more than 1 in 3 has high blood pressure.

conclusion: When you leave the employer's group cover and bought a fresh policy, the waiting periods starts from zero and Indian adults have diabetes and high blood pressure.

text: Samajh aata hai aapko lagta hai extra pay karna zaroori nahi hai. Based on IRDAI circular IRDAI/HLT/REG/CIR/003/01/2020, this means employer cover belongs to the employer's group policy; the option to move it into your own name applies only when you exit the group. Aapke liye kya badlaav aayega agar aap job change karte hain aur group cover khatam ho jata hai?

text: Aap sahi keh rahe hain. Based on IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business, 29 May 2024, paras 11–12, this means a fresh policy bought after leaving a job, rather than migrated, starts its waiting periods from zero. Agar aapko future mein koi chronic condition ho jaye, aap is waiting period ko kaise dekhte hain?

text: Aapne kaha ki aapke employer ka 5 lakh ka group cover hai, lekin IRDAI circular IRDAI/HLT/REG/CIR/003/01/2020 ke mutabik yeh cover sirf employer ke group policy tak hi limited hai aur aapke apne naam mein tabhi transfer hota hai jab aap group se bahar jaate hain. Aur IRDAI Master Circular 29 May 2024 ke paras 11‑12 ke hisaab se, job chhodne ke baad nayi policy lene par waiting periods zero se shuru hote hain, jabki ICMR-INDIAB-17 ke mutabik bahut saare Indian adults ko diabetes ya hypertension ka risk hota hai, isliye apni alag policy rakhna faydemand ho sakta hai.
